title: io.github.yairsabag.policy.cancellation
description: Time-tiered, anchor-relative cancellation policy for UCP policies[]. Body shape per the composition pattern discussed in Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp#572.

anchor.description: The reference moment the policy is anchored to (check-in, event start, delivery date). Tier deadlines count backwards from this moment.

tiers.description: Ordered from farthest to nearest to the anchor. Semantic constraints (not expressible in JSON Schema): 'until' durations MUST be strictly decreasing in proximity order (each tier closer to the anchor than the previous), and 'buyer_bps' MUST be strictly decreasing (a later deadline never refunds more).

until.description: ISO 8601 duration BEFORE the anchor until which this tier applies (e.g. 'P7D' = up to 7 days before anchor).

buyer_bps.description: Basis points of the amount returned to the buyer on self-cancellation within this tier (10000 = 100%).

after_last_tier_bps.description: Buyer entitlement after the last tier's deadline has passed (typically 0).
